snippet.title: Avaryn | Devlog 1: Races, Lands and How a Fight Works | Tower Defense MMORPG
snippet.description:
Devlog 1 walks you through Avaryn: the four races you can play and where each of them begins, the lands between them, how a fight works, what has happened in the world, and what we have left for you to find.

Sign up at https://playavaryn.com. We may invite players that signed up for access at our own discretion.

4:03 What has happened

#Avaryn #TowerDefense #MMORPG

Avaryn is a Tower Defense MMORPG played in your browser. Pick a race and a class, quest with friends, and when the enemy marches, build towers and fight beside them.

Play: https://playavaryn.com
Founder packs: https://playavaryn.com/shop
Wiki: https://wiki.playavaryn.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/6RsHb8j9kn
